Method of Attack: Blocks malicious programs or code that can damage your system
Blocks online scams, including technical support scams, browser lockers, and phishing
Blocks third-party ads and third-party ad trackers that monitor your online activity
Blocks content and websites that often display behavior of questionable value (clickbait protection)
Blocks the downloading of potentially unwanted programs, including toolbars and pop-ups
Heuristically detects and blocks browser tech support scams including new ones
Blocks known URLs that harvest malware and adware
Attack Vector: Browser extension installed from Chrome Web Store or Firefox Extension pages
Indicators of Compromise: Known or heuristically detected tech support scam URLs
Fraud and other malicious sites URLs
Blocked ads and tracking scripts count shown in extension icon
Telemetry data containing blocking category and URL sent to Malwarebytes (can be disabled)
